result.brief: 提出 SparK-SAR：基于 ConvNeXt 的稀疏卷积掩码自监督预训练框架，改造 stem 步幅与轻量重建解码器，降低显存并提升 Sentinel-1 SAR 下游表征性能。
result.reason: Proposes sparse convolutional masked pretraining (SparK+ConvNeXt) for SAR imagery, with encoder/decoder design and CKA representation analysis — a self-supervised visual representation contribution.
